test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

What **__should I doing__** if the power goes out?
solution:
The correct answer is "should I do."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"should I doing."**
 
• The error in the original sentence is the use of **"doing"** after** "should I."**
 
• The use of the auxiliary verb **"should" **with** "doing"** is incorrect. 
 
• The correct form is **"What should I do"** to create a grammatically accurate question.
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.**
 

Correct sentence:* ****What **should I do**__ if the power goes out?*
